name: Video player
purpose: Displays and controls digital video within a layout — play/pause, scrub, time and related controls overlaid on the video. Standard inline player and a larger hero variant.

props.name: variant
props.$note: Standard inline player vs full-width hero player.

props.name: state
props.$note: Playback states (multiple state rows shown on the page).

variants.name: standard
variants.use: Inline video player within page/layout content.

tokens.controls-icon: icon/default-reverse (#ffffff — controls overlaid on the video)
tokens.icon-on-light: icon/default (#333 — controls on a light surface)
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) Controls render as literals (white icon/default-reverse + red primary accent + a dark gradient scrim) because controls-on-video must hold contrast over ANY frame regardless of theme — a special on-media context, conceptually icon/default-reverse + primary + overlay/version2.

accessibility.controls: All controls (play/pause, scrub, volume, fullscreen, captions) must be keyboard-operable with accessible names
accessibility.captions: Provide captions/subtitles and, where needed, a transcript / audio description (1.2.2 / 1.2.5)
accessibility.autoplay: Don't autoplay with sound; any autoplaying/looping video must be pausable and respect prefers-reduced-motion (2.2.2)
accessibility.contrast: Overlaid white controls must stay legible over varied video frames — use a scrim/affordance, not colour alone

antiPatterns: Autoplaying video with sound / no pause control
Controls that aren't keyboard reachable or lack labels
Relying on white control icons over uncontrolled video without a scrim for contrast

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — CLEAN, no deprecated tokens. Both standard + hero share the same token set.

depricateUsage.note: None. Controls icon/default-reverse + icon/default, play accent primary/background/default, caption text/default font-6 medium.
